Removing

Refitting

1. Undo the nut (1a) fixing the bracket (1b) to the rigid low pressure pipe (1c).

2. Disconnect the low pressure fuel supply pipe rapid connector.

3. Undo the connectors and remove the rigid low pressure pipe (1c).

Refitting

Removing

- Place the rigid low pressure pipe in position and tighten the connectors.

- Connect the low pressure fuel supply pipe rapid connector.

- Tighten the nut fixing the bracket to the rigid low pressure pipe.

The low pressure pipe to the fuel pressure pump is provided by the Parts dept. together with the high pressure pipe, therefore refer toOp. 1056F79 FUEL PIPE (DUPLEX) FROM PRESSURE PUMP TO FUEL MANIFOLD - R.R.
